description: Reconcile the brand list: correct two country codes and add three makers.
rationale: A MERGE keyed on name, which house.brand has a unique constraint on. That constraint is not decoration: MERGE's ON clause is not a key constraint, and against a table with two rows sharing a key one source row would silently update both. pg_laswell refuses a merge whose key has no unique index behind it, which is why this is safe to write as an upsert at all. when_not_matched_by_source is deliberately absent -- this is a reconciliation of the rows named here, not a replacement of the table.

assert_invariants.name: no_brand_loses_its_name
assert_invariants.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM house.brand WHERE name IS NULL OR name = ''
